ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar May-18-2006 Text Ruling

AMENDED ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar May-18-2006 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of an Adult and of a Minor.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Tony Vaughn.
Petitioner: Mui A. Loc, present in pro per for self and as Guardian ad litem for, and with the Minor: Tat Y. Khi Mau, and with Cantonese Interpreter: Lay Khi Mau-Yao.
Petitioner and Interpreter were sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of an Adult to: Xena Loc, and grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Andrey Mau.
Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Apr-06-2006 Reset To May-18-06 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of an adult and a Minor.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: E. Bura/S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Yvonne Lee.
Petitioner: Mui A. Loc, present in pro per and as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Tat Y. Khi Mau. Interpreter: Lai Khi Mau-Yao, present, for petitioner. Parties were sworn and examined.
Petitioner must properly serve the Minor's father and submit a proof of service to the court. The OSC for Change of Name of the petitioner: Mui A. Loc and the Minor: Tat Y. Khi Mau, was continued to May 18, 2006 at 9:00 a.m. in Dept. 218.
